what: Patreon positions itself as an alternative business model to the entire ad-based internet ecosystem, offering membership and commerce as sustainable revenue streams.
verbatim_snippet: "On Patreon, you can build a lasting business outside of the ad-based ecosystem, with revenue streams ranging from membership for offering ongoing benefits, to online shops for selling individual videos, podcast episodes, and more."
notes: Self-positioning (sub-type a). Same URL as F-P07; distinct claim. "Outside of the ad-based ecosystem" frames the entire ad-supported web as the competitive alternative. Dimension: business model (subscription vs. ad-supported).
